two_self_corrections_worth_reviewing:
1. VACUITY CAUGHT IN MY OWN TEST. My first #195 tests asserted on the new `rejections=`
   keyword and the new PageAssessment field. At main_sha they failed with
   `TypeError: reconstruct_table_regions() got an unexpected keyword argument 'rejections'`
   — exactly the vacuous shape the non-vacuity rule exists to catch, since a reverted fix
   would fail on a signature error rather than on behaviour. Replaced with a test that drives
   the REAL BornDigitalDetector over GH-144's own regression fixture and asserts on
   state.events, naming no symbol the fix introduces.

2. CONTRADICTORY FIXTURE. My first #198 fixture modelled the raw cell as "0.67" (star
   dropped, value intact). That is the DECORATION case, not a boundary split — it made the
   defect test and the reverse-regression test assert opposite things about identical inputs,
   and the defect test failed on my own branch. The fixture now models the cell as "0" (the
   value itself cut), the actual GH-144 mechanism.
deliberately_unchanged:
- Page and document STATUS for #195. The word-geometry fallback is proven lossless
  (GH-144 A1 §2 control), so the page ships CORRECT values; flagging the document as damaged
  would be a false signal. The event says "this layout is adversarial to the text strategy,
  worth spot-checking", which is what the issue asks for.
- RESIDUAL GAP, stated in the PR body: decoration-only loss (0.67*** rendered as 0.67) is NOT
  treated as destruction. The significance marker is lost and the grid is kept. That follows
  the issue's own guidance, but it is a real remaining gap, not something the fix covers.
- _destroyed_numeric_tokens' conservative "any ambiguity counts as destroyed" contract
  (no-cell / cell=None / grid-missing / grid-none) — untouched.
- _NUM_TOKEN_RE itself and its other call sites (has_numeric_columns, _looks_tabular, the
  rowizer). Only the destruction check's candidate filter was widened, and as a UNION so no
  previously-checked token stops being checked.
